aiMetadata.description: Sends an email through Azure Communication Services from a verified sender address, supporting either plain-text or HTML body via the content type selector. Use to deliver transactional or notification email when the workflow is wired to an Azure Communication Services connection. Requires a sender address provisioned in the Azure resource and at least one recipient; not idempotent — each call dispatches a new message.
